summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py as the last method of Graph (before ConjunctiveGraph), with a nested add_to_cbd helper covering the three CBD rules: subject triples, recursion into BNode objects guarded by whether the result already has triples with that subject, and reification via rdf:subject reifiers without type or predicate/object matching. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py (class CbdTestCase) with an inline Turtle fixture and tests for rules 1 and 2 counts (R1=5, R2=3, unknown=0), typed and untyped reifiers (R5=8, R6=13), incoming reification (A1=5, B1=0), blank node in reification not expanded (R8=4), blank-node cycle (R9=3), and source immutability. Nothing was run, per instructions; expected counts were derived by hand. No commits made. Please run test/test_graph_cbd.py to confirm.
